brief:
As Israel prepares for elections, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's most significant domestic legacy may be the right-wing opposition he has fostered, Al Jazeera English reported. The political landscape he helped create now includes challengers within his own ideological camp who have gathered considerable support.

Netanyahu's years in office have produced a fragmented conservative movement where rivals contest for leadership of the right. The emergence of competing right-wing figures reflects deep divisions over strategy, governance, and vision for Israel's future that have crystallized during his tenure.
dek: As Israel heads to the polls, PM Netanyahu’s most enduring domestic legacy may be the right-wing opposition he faces.
title: Netanyahu's political rivals reshape Israel's right wing
